The '''Sentient Armor''' is a type of [[Armor]].

== ''Obtainment'' ==
Obtainable only throughout Cheats or using Creative Mode.

== ''Usage'' ==
Like any armor set, Sentient Armor can be worn for extra protection.

== ''Properties'' ==
The Sentient Armor grants its user access to the [[Adaptation System]], permitting them to adapt to a total of 7 Damage Types.  Adaptation data can be seen by hovering over each item in the inventory.
